preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

postconditions.expression: all(input[i] == output[i] for i in range(len(input)) if input[i] == ' ')
postconditions.description: All spaces in the input string are retained in the same positions in the output.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == input[j] for i, j in enumerate(reversed(range(len(input)))) if input[j] != ' ')
postconditions.description: Each non-space character in the output is the reverse of the corresponding non-space character in the input, preserving word boundaries.
